guidance: Write concrete, testable user journeys and measurable requirements for a new or materially evolving product capability, whether the product is new or existing. Prefer named users, observable outcomes, and numbers over backlog fluff. Do not invent scope, personas, or metrics you cannot verify. Do not use this template for a bounded amendment (Change Request) or an unintended defect (Bug Fix Spec).

outline.title: Product Context
outline.guidance: Frame the problem, who it affects, and what is in or out of this PRD. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Problem
children.guidance: State the user pain or business inefficiency in 2–4 sentences. Name who is blocked and what fails today.

children.title: Audience
children.guidance: Name the primary users and any secondary stakeholders. Do not invent personas.

children.title: Goals and Non-Goals
children.guidance: List 1–3 measurable outcomes this PRD must achieve, then name what is explicitly out of scope. Do not treat a non-goal as a later stretch item.

outline.title: User Journeys
outline.guidance: Group the end-to-end flows that prove the product works. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: User Journey
children.guidance: Title each instance with the user goal or scenario name, not "User Journey".

children.title: User Need
children.guidance: State who is acting and what they must accomplish. One need per journey.

children.title: Journey
children.guidance: Describe the observable steps from trigger to outcome. A stranger should be able to walk this path.

children.title: Acceptance Criteria
children.guidance: Bullet list of specific, testable done-conditions for this journey. Prefer pass/fail checks over adjectives.

outline.title: Requirements
outline.guidance: Group the product capabilities this PRD commits to. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Requirement
children.guidance: Title each instance with the capability name, not "Requirement".

children.title: Intent
children.guidance: State what the product must do and why, in one or two sentences. Do not hide multiple capabilities in one instance.

children.title: Acceptance Criteria
children.guidance: Bullet list of specific, testable done-conditions for this requirement.

children.title: Success Metric
children.guidance: Name one measurable threshold that proves this requirement worked. Omit if no metric is known yet.

outline.title: Delivery Context
outline.guidance: Capture what must be true around the requirements, not how to implement them. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Dependencies and Constraints
children.guidance: List known systems, teams, dates, or policy limits this PRD depends on. Do not invent unknowns as facts.

children.title: Risks
children.guidance: List the delivery, adoption, or scope risks that could invalidate this PRD. Name likelihood and impact in one line each.

children.title: Open Questions
children.guidance: List unresolved decisions that block a complete PRD. Omit if none remain.
